description: This PHP class 'TranslationHelper' manages translation data for the OrangeHRM system, including adding translations from YAML files, interacting with the database to store and retrieve translation records, and handling language and group identifiers.

classes.name: TranslationHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing translation data, including loading from YAML files and database interactions for translations.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the TranslationHelper with a database connection.

methods.name: addTranslations
methods.description: Loads translation data from a YAML file in a specified directory and adds them to the database.

methods.name: saveTranslationRecord
methods.description: Saves a translation record into the database, creating new entries if necessary.

methods.name: getLangStringHelper
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of LangStringHelper.

methods.name: getLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves the language ID from the database based on language code.

methods.name: createQueryBuilder
methods.description: Creates and returns a new QueryBuilder instance.

methods.name: getTranslationRecord
methods.description: Fetches an existing translation record ID from the database.
